subject: Workplace Skills
title: Sleep and Cognitive Performance
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Sleep and Cognitive Performance.

hook.text: After 17 hours awake, your cognitive function equals a blood alcohol level of 0.05. Drowsy is impaired.

buildup.text: Sleep consolidates memory, clears metabolic waste, and restores prefrontal cortex function for decisions.

discovery.text: Six hours of sleep for ten nights produces the same impairment as staying awake for 24 hours straight.

twist.text: People who sleep six hours think they have adapted. Tests prove they have not. Self-assessment is unreliable.

climax.text: Treat sleep as a performance tool, not a luxury. Protect seven to eight hours like a critical meeting.

punchline.text: Sleep is not lost time. It is an investment.

quiz.question: What happens after ten nights of only six hours of sleep?
options: Your body fully adapts to the reduced schedule
Impairment equals staying awake for 24 hours straight
